_readme: Stage 3 records in this file are public-scope screens only. A scope_screened record means the relevant standard and published scope/edition were identified from official or publisher catalogue data. It is NOT a clause-by-clause review of licensed text and must remain Partial until the exact clauses, tables and project-adopted edition are checked. Do not enter approved reviewer details unless a qualified person has actually approved the calculator.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Scope screening only; verify the exact project edition, clauses, cable tables and assumptions.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52; IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AC wiring-system voltage-drop and conductor resistance context are relevant. The calculator uses a simplified R/X equation; verify the conductor operating temperature, reactance, circuit layout and permitted drop.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1-2; IEC 61820-3-2; FAA AC 150/5345-10H
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series circuit and CCR requirements are relevant. The lamp power/current relationship is entered as an exponent-based model; actual brightness-step currents, lamp data and CCR output data must come from approved equipment documentation.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1-2; IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series-circuit cable context and conductor resistance/size requirements are relevant. The calculator estimates loop resistance and I²R loss; confirm cable construction, circuit topology, operating temperature and actual manufacturer resistance.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1-2; IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series-circuit cable context and conductor dimensions/resistance are relevant. The calculator solves a user-defined loss limit; the selected limit is not a standard-prescribed value and final selection needs full circuit checks.

standard.name: IEC 61820-3-2; FAA AC 150/5345-10H
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series-circuit power-supply and CCR specification context is relevant. The calculator estimates input power, energy and cost from user-entered efficiency and power factor; it does not model CCR loss curves or metering accuracy.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1; IEC 61820-1-2; IEC 61820-3-2; FAA AC 150/5345-10H
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL fundamental principles, series-circuit requirements and CCR/power-supply requirements are relevant. The calculator estimates circuit load and CCR size; fitting-specific data, cable resistance, regulator limits and project requirements must be verified.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1-2; FAA AC 150/5345-47B
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series-circuit requirements and the FAA series-to-series isolation-transformer specification are relevant. Verify transformer type, VA rating, leakage, insulation, secondary loading and current FAA qualification status against the actual procurement specification.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1-2; FAA AC 150/5345-47B
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series-circuit and isolation-transformer context is relevant. Open-secondary voltage/power behaviour is manufacturer-specific; the calculator requires user-entered failed-lamp/open-secondary assumptions and is indicative.

standard.name: IEC 61820-1; IEC 61820-1-2; IEC 61820-3-2; FAA AC 150/5345-10H
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: AGL series-circuit and CCR requirements are relevant. The calculator estimates a maximum fitting count from user-entered lamp, transformer and cable data; it does not replace CCR load curves or manufacturer limits.

standard.name: IEEE 485; IEC 62485-2
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Stationary lead-acid battery sizing and stationary battery safety are relevant. IEEE 485 applies to lead-acid float-service applications; the calculator is a simplified energy estimate and does not implement duty-cycle sizing.

standard.name: IEC 60364-4-43; IEC 60947-2
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Overcurrent protection and LV circuit-breaker product requirements are relevant. The calculator only rounds a user-margined current to a nominal rating; it does not check breaking capacity, trip curves, selectivity or local adoption.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Cable current-carrying capacity and correction factors are relevant. The in-app square-root temperature factor is a simplified heat-balance approximation, not a tabulated IEC derating factor; group and other factors are user inputs.

standard.name: IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Conductor classes, nominal cross-sectional areas and DC resistance are in scope. The calculator uses material resistivity and an approximate temperature correction; verify resistance against the cable datasheet and standard tables.

standard.name: IEC 60364-4-43; IEC 60949
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Overcurrent protection and thermally permissible cable short-circuit current are relevant. The calculator uses S = I√t/k; confirm the correct k value, initial/final temperatures and adiabatic applicability in the project edition.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52; IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Wiring-system voltage-drop design and conductor dimensions/resistance are relevant. The calculator is a first-pass size estimate; confirm the actual cable data, installation method and permissible drop.

standard.name: IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Conductor resistance and construction are in scope. The linear temperature coefficient is a material approximation; confirm actual conductor resistance and temperature limits from the cable standard and manufacturer.

standard.name: NFPA 70
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: The calculator uses the NEC conduit/conductor fill percentages (53%, 31%, 40%). This is applicable only where the relevant NFPA 70 edition and Chapter 9 rules are adopted; cable types and local amendments must be checked.

standard.name: IEC 60381-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Industrial analogue DC signal ranges are covered by this standard. The calculator performs a user-defined linear scaling and does not check transmitter, receiver, loop-power or accuracy requirements.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52; IEC 60228
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: DC wiring-system design, conductor dimensions and resistance are relevant. The calculation is a simplified resistive drop estimate and does not check ampacity, protective-device coordination or installation conditions.

standard.name: IEEE 80; IEEE 81; IEC 60364-5-54
standard.edition: IEEE 80-2013 (inactive-reserved legacy guide); IEEE 81-2025; IEC 60364-5-54:2011 + A1:2021 Ed 3.1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Substation grounding-grid safety/design and field measurement are relevant. The calculator is a simplified resistance estimate only; it does not evaluate touch/step voltage, grid geometry, current division or fault duration.

standard.name: IEEE 81; IEC 60364-5-54
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Grounding-system field measurement and earthing arrangements are relevant. The calculator uses a theoretical single-rod approximation in uniform soil; it is not a substitute for soil measurements or site testing.

standard.name: IEEE 81; IEC 60364-5-54
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Ground-electrode measurement and earthing arrangements are relevant. R/n with a utilisation factor is an approximation; mutual resistance, spacing, soil layering and seasonal variation are not modelled.

standard.name: IEC 60909-0
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Short-circuit current calculation for three-phase AC systems. The calculator is a transformer-impedance estimate and does not assemble a complete network model or apply every IEC correction factor.

standard.name: IEC 60364-4-41; IEC 60364-5-54
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Automatic disconnection of supply, earth-fault loop impedance and protective conductors are directly relevant. The calculator uses a simplified TN-loop relation; system type, conductor temperature, measured Ze, protective-device trip characteristic and required disconnection time must be verified.

standard.name: IEC 60909-0
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Short-circuit level in three-phase AC systems is the governing context. The calculator converts a supplied three-phase fault current to MVA; it does not calculate the fault current itself.

standard.name: IEC 60909-0
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Short-circuit calculations for three-phase AC systems, including fault types and sequence networks, are relevant. The calculator is a simplified symmetrical-component estimate and assumes the sequence impedances entered represent the complete source path.

standard.name: ISO 8528-1
standard.edition: 2018 Ed 3 (published edition; Ed 4 DIS was under development at review date)
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Defines generating-set application, ratings and performance. The calculator only estimates kVA from kW, power factor and a user margin; load steps, ambient derating and engine/alternator ratings are not assessed.

standard.name: IEEE 519; IEC 61000-4-7
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Harmonic control at the point of common coupling and harmonic measurement instrumentation are relevant. The calculator only combines selected 3rd, 5th and 7th currents; it is not a full spectrum, TDD or compliance assessment.

standard.name: IEC 60034-27-4
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Recommended test procedures for insulation resistance and polarisation index of rotating-machine windings are relevant. The calculator computes ratios only; test voltage, temperature correction, acceptance criteria and machine-specific limits remain outside scope.

standard.name: ISO/CIE 8995-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Indoor workplace lighting requirements and maintained-illuminance criteria are relevant. The lumen-method equation is a simplified planning method; use luminaire photometry, room data and project-specific criteria for design.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Wiring-system selection and voltage-drop context. The calculator solves a simplified voltage-drop equation; it does not verify ampacity, fault protection or installation method.

standard.name: IEC 60034-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Rotating-machine rating and performance context. The equation estimates input current from output power, efficiency, power factor and voltage; nameplate data takes precedence.

standard.name: IEC 60034-12; IEC 60909-0
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Motor starting performance and supply-system short-circuit strength are relevant context. The voltage-dip equation is a simplified source-impedance estimate, not a complete motor-starting or network study.

standard.name: IEC 60034-12
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Starting performance of single-speed three-phase cage induction motors is relevant. The in-app DOL/star-delta/autotransformer ratios are simplified estimates; use motor-manufacturer starting-current and torque data.

standard.name: IEC 60076-25
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Neutral grounding resistors for power transformers are covered. The calculator derives resistance, duty power and energy from selected voltage/current/time; check system grounding philosophy, duty cycle, tolerances and thermal rating.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Parallel conductor installation and current-carrying capacity are relevant. The calculator estimates set count from user-supplied ampacity and factors; it does not verify equal current sharing, cable arrangement, terminals or derating tables.

standard.name: ISO/IEC 30134-2
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Defines data-centre PUE measurement, calculation and reporting. The calculator implements the basic total-facility-power / IT-equipment-power ratio; metering boundaries and reporting conditions must follow the standard.

standard.name: IEC 62548-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: PV-array design and DC-system protection are relevant. The energy-demand sizing formula is a preliminary estimate; module configuration, inverter limits, shading, storage and site yield require separate design checks.

standard.name: IEC 61724-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: PV-system performance monitoring and performance-ratio terminology are relevant. The calculator is a simplified peak-sun-hours × performance-ratio estimate, not an IEC monitoring or yield-prediction implementation.

standard.name: IEC 62548-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: PV-array design, DC wiring and protective provisions are relevant to cold-voltage string checks. Confirm module Voc and temperature coefficient, inverter maximum voltage and local code requirements.

standard.name: IEC 60751
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Industrial platinum resistance thermometers and sensors, including the resistance-temperature relationship, are directly relevant. Confirm tolerance class, connection arrangement, self-heating and temperature range.

standard.name: IEC 60034-12
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Starting performance for single-speed three-phase cage induction motors is relevant. The one-third current/torque relationships are idealised star-delta estimates; actual motor design, transition and load torque affect performance.

standard.name: IEC 60076-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: General power-transformer requirements and ratings. The calculator uses the three-phase apparent-power/current identity, not a full transformer design method.

standard.name: IEC 60076-1; IEC 60076-7
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Transformer ratings and loading guidance are relevant. The calculator estimates apparent load from measured voltage/current; thermal loading and life assessment are not included.

standard.name: IEC 60076-1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Power-transformer rating and performance context. The calculator uses user-entered resistance/impedance data and an approximate regulation relationship; confirm the test basis and sign convention.

standard.name: IEC 60076-1; IEC 60076-7
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Power-transformer ratings and, for mineral-oil-immersed units, loading/thermal ageing are relevant. The calculator sizes from kW, power factor, growth and a selected loading fraction; it does not check harmonics, cooling, ambient or cyclic load.

standard.name: IEC 62040-3; IEEE 485
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: UPS performance and stationary lead-acid battery sizing are relevant. The runtime equation is an energy-balance estimate, not a guaranteed discharge curve; IEEE 485 applies only to lead-acid stationary batteries in float service.

standard.name: IEC 60364-5-52
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Wiring-system selection and voltage-drop context. The calculator is a simplified estimate; allowable drop depends on the installation code, circuit use and project specification.

standard.name: ANSI/NEMA MG 1
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: The calculator uses the maximum-deviation-from-average definition published in NEMA MG 1. IEC 60034-26:2026 addresses effects of unbalanced voltages on three-phase cage motors but uses a different analytical context; do not interchange definitions.

standard.name: ASTM B258
standard.review_basis: Official/public publisher catalogue and published scope metadata; no licensed clause text reviewed
standard.scope_note: Defines nominal diameters and cross-sectional areas for AWG solid round wires. This is a gauge conversion only and does not establish ampacity or suitability.
